name: _enabled
doc: Generic component flag accepted on biome components; its effect here was not traced

name: check_safety
doc: if set, will check the 4 corners for safty

name: rand_seed
doc: uses this to randomize the positions

name: tree_radius_high
doc: within the tree width what's the max distance (1) all the way to right

name: tree_probability
doc: what's the probability of a tree being spawned in a tree_width section

name: is_rare
doc: if true, the tree is spawned only 1/3 of cases

name: tree_extra_y
doc: if is_visual is true, then this will move it down by this much (range 0..50)

name: visual_color
doc: is_visual=1, the color of the single cell that is created for the plant

name: height_check
doc: if != 0 will check that there is air up to this height

name: max_y
doc: this is the max y that the plant / tree can be placed

name: random_flip_x_scale
doc: if true, has 50% chance of being flipped horizontally
